review:
Big Bob and his boat Bettsy the Beaut chase a marlin on a 5x4 grid that pays on both paylines and LootLines.

It's a relaxed beach-fishing theme, but in the bonus it's all about collecting values across the grid, like most Hacksaw fishing games. Hacksaw lists a 10,000x max but doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game, so check the info screen in the demo. Hacksaw's take on the Big Bass style.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
